weekend: Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October 2026 (plus Mon 19 MLS in the original top-flight set)
method: Independent model. No prediction, odds or xG figures from any prediction site are used. Inputs are real events only: goals scored/conceded in league matches this season (league tables), the league's goals-per-match average, and team news. Confirmed absences adjust a team's attack by the stated multiplier. Rumours are listed separately, labelled UNVERIFIED, and are given a multiplier of 1.0 (no effect) unless confirmed by a club. Expanded set: the original 11 top-flight fixtures plus lower-division fixtures (EFL Championship, League One, League Two, Serie B). For the lower-league teams no club-confirmed news adjustment was sourced, so attack_adj = 1.00 and the picks rest on real scoring/conceding records only. No prediction site's picks, odds or xG are used anywhere. Japan added 17 Oct: J1 (8 Saturday fixtures), J2 (9) and J3 (6). Because of the time difference those matches had kicked off before this run, so every team's record was restored to pre-match by subtracting today's result from the published table; today's scores themselves are never used as inputs.
